new.where: Settings, Diagnostics, Read Your Recording (the review), the button row, the last button: saves the zip, copies the summary, shows the file and opens the page where reports go

new.english: Save and Post saves the zip, copies the summary, shows the file in Explorer and opens PadForge’s page where reports go. Paste the summary there and drop the file on it.
new.where: Read Your Recording, the line under the button row, above the footnote

The device note over the game (bottom center of the screen in front): the note that said a device disconnected turns to this in place when the device comes back while the note shows. {0} is the device's name
The device note over the game: a note that named several devices that disconnected together turns to this in place when all of them are back. {0} is how many (two or more), {1} their names

changed.where: The Windows message box shown when PadForge meets an error it did not expect: {0} is the error's message, {1} its stack, {2} the address of a new Q&A discussion on PadForge's GitHub page. The new sentence sits between the message and the stack, since a message box cuts off what does not fit the screen.

The device note over the game for a device that dropped three times or more within a minute. {0} is the device's name, {1} the count (three or more), which grows in the same note while it shows. Was "{0} keeps disconnecting"
